items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: we had a thing where we wanted Eubie Blake and Willie the Lion Smith

ctx.x: I just didn't know it, because we had a thing where we wanted Eubie Blake and Willie the Lion Smith, and let me see, who else -- Eubie's still the only one living, but we wanted to get a conversation in retrospect, in the old time, the James P. Johnson days, you know.
